section.div: The-Honored-One A premium, interactive Satoru Gojo dossier featuring glassmorphism UI, dynamic 'Infinity' analytics, and immersive 'Unlimited Void' effects. Built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap.
Student-Performance-Analysis-Dashboard A Streamlit web app that automatically cleans raw student data, visualizes performance trends, and predicts exam marks using Scikit-Learn based on study habits.
DrugGuard-Detection-System An algospeak-resilient Chrome extension with FastAPI backend that uses Naive Bayes and RapidOCR to detect and blur illicit drug content on webpages in real time.

div.div:
Ichigo Kurosaki is a rather normal high school student apart from the fact he has the ability to see ghosts. This ability never impacted his life in a major way until the day he encounters the Shinigami Kuchiki Rukia, who saves him and his family's lives from a Hollow, a corrupt spirit that devours human souls.
Wounded during the fight against the Hollow, Rukia chooses the only option available to defeat the monster and passes her Shinigami powers to Ichigo. Now forced to act as a substitute until Rukia recovers, Ichigo hunts down the Hollows that plague his town.

Light Yagami is a genius high school student who is about to learn about life through a book of death. When a bored shinigami, a God of Death, named Ryuk drops a black notepad called a Death Note, Light receives power over life and death with the stroke of a pen. Determined to use this dark gift for the best, Light sets out to rid the world of evil… namely, the people he believes to be evil. Should anyone hold such power? The consequences of Light’s actions will set the world ablaze. (Source: VIZ Media)
